decision.title: The query AST for XQuery and the parser part seam (packet )

item.p: Kinds: 66 XQuery kinds appended to sxml_ast_kind, one per new visible node type of grammars/xquery (SXML_AST_KIND_<NODE TYPE>); allowing_empty is absorbed as flag ALLOWING_EMPTY. 24 fields appended (the grammar's, plus MODULE, which the front end gives the child of module, the one named child without a grammar field). Tokens in fields /kind become the new detail (PRESERVE, STRIP, ORDERED, ..., LAX, STRICT); the decimal-format property name the detail (sxml/xpath.h's kind); the other XQuery tokens flags (FIXED, EXTERNAL, STABLE, DESCENDING, EMPTY_GREATEST, EMPTY_LEAST, ONLY, STATIC, PRESERVE_NAMESPACES, INHERIT_NAMESPACES). Front-end marks: BOUNDARY_WHITESPACE on direct element text, NAMESPACE_DECLARATION_ATTRIBUTE on xmlns attributes. Leaves: QNAME has a name payload, the direct text kinds, CDATA, comments, pragma contents and string constructor characters a decoded text, a direct PI the new payload processing_instruction (target, content). The header writes out AST and IR of five XQuery examples (group by, a tumbling window, a direct constructor with namespaces, try/catch/finally, a prolog function).

Parser part seam: sxml_ast_build_with_parser_part(request, part, &ast) runs the one XPath walker (: iterative, A.3.2 and lookup key checks, depth bound) with a part's language and root node type, its sorted node type and field tables (consulted after XPath's), unnamed child fields, and three stateless hooks: apply_token (claims a token before the XPath rules), describe_payload (fills a payload before the XPath decoders, e.g. XQuery string literals with references) and finish_node (called once per node when it is complete, leaves at once; for XQST0118, XQST0040, boundary whitespace). Hooks reach the AST and source text through the opaque sxml_ast_front_end, add flags with sxml_ast_add_flags, and raise any err: code with sxml_ast_front_end_raise (the error record gets that code). Without a part the walk is unchanged: all 32,928 applicable XP40 queries build byte-identical ASTs. With a scratch part of only the tables, all 43,663 valid XQ40 queries and the 145 parsable library modules build.

Who writes what: 3.2 defines sxml_xquery_build_ast (declared now) and its part in src/xquery_parse.c; it needs sxml_grammar_xquery added to the sxml link line of the root CMakeLists.txt (one word, 3.2 adds it). Parts are passed by each entry point, not registered by glob: the entry point chooses the grammar.
tests/xpath_parse_test.c's kind and field name tables grow with the enumerations (static asserts); 3.1 appended the XQuery names.

Rejected: a parser registry by glob (one grammar per entry point, so nothing to discover); the XQuery tables in xpath_parse.c (the part owns its grammar's names, as lowering parts own their kinds); hook state pointers (everything a hook needs is in the AST).
